annonce.rivals.title: The Network: First Rivals Announcement
annonce.rivals.description: The Network, the supreme political council, announces the very first Rivals.
annonce.rivals.text: In the center of the table, a hologram projected a three-dimensional representation of the Milky Way, tinged with a dark and oppressive aura. The stars twinkled like distant promises, while the planets stood like mute sentinels in the cosmic void. But behind this cosmic beauty hid the scourge of overpopulation.</br></br> The President of the Network, his face marked by the trials of power, spoke in a hoarse voice full of emotion. "My colleagues, we have arrived at a crossroads. The galaxy is choking under the weight of our own existence. Resources are running out, life support systems are faltering, and internecine wars threaten to tear our fragile balance apart." </br> A heavy silence fell over the room, leaving a palpable anxiety. Everyone knew that the decision that was going to be made would be one of desperation and sacrifice. "We must find a solution, a path to restore harmony to our galactic home. A path that can only be traced by fire and blood," the President continued in a trembling voice. The members of the Network exchanged looks full of doubt and resignation. They knew what was to come, and it filled them with deep sadness. </br></br> "The Rivals", one of them whispered, his voice barely audible. "A century-old event where the planets will designate Ashaks to fight to the death. A purge to ease the burden of overpopulation." The words hung in the air, like sharp blades ready to slice the fate of the innocent.</br> The President's face hardened, marked by the bitterness of this decision. "Yes, Rivals. A dance of death where six Ashaks will pit themselves against each other, each representing their home planet. The arena will be their final battlefield, a dark and merciless ordeal." </ br> Tension intensified in the room, the members of the Network feeling the weight of their decisions on their shoulders. Everyone wondered if this proposal was the only possible outcome or the fruit of unspeakable cruelty. "Those who survive, if they survive, will be the last hopes of our exhausted worlds. The five losers, with their people, will be condemned to exile in nothingness, a fate kinder than the slow agony of overpopulation. " </br></br> A funeral silence enveloped the members of the Network, their minds prey to pain and doubt. But deep in their hearts, they knew it was the only path they could take to save their moribund galaxy. And so, in the darkness of that meeting room, where the stars seemed to go out one by one, the fate of the galaxy was sealed. The Rivals would be the embodiment of their despair, a sinister glimmer of hope in a world on the edge of the precipice. They knew their decision would be judged by future generations, condemned to oscillate between horror and necessity, in the dark and forgotten annals of galactic history.

wicaksanas.1.title: The Wicaksanas: A singular clan
wicaksanas.1.description: The Wicaksanas, a clan of the Milky Way, are distinguished by their singular appearance, the result of natural evolution driven by their environment.
wicaksanas.1.text: The Wicaksanas, a clan of the Milky Way, are distinguished by their singular appearance, the result of natural evolution driven by their environment. Their physiognomy is far removed from that of original humanity, sporting a bluish tint to their skin and delicately curved horns that emerge from their faces. Their prominent jaws add a touch of mystery and power to their appearance.</br></br>What makes Wicaksanas truly remarkable is their unparalleled mastery of natural resources, particularly crystals and purplebark resins. Their home planet, Samun, is full of these treasures sought across the galaxy. The Wicaksanas have developed a deep symbiosis with these raw materials, using them as catalysts for their power. At their side, their potential increases tenfold, giving them extraordinary abilities and extraordinary powers.</br></br>Despite their imposing appearance and their exceptional skills, the Wicaksanas are a pacifist people, guided by a philosophy of respect and harmony with nature. On their home planet, they live in harmony with ecosystems, advocating the preservation of the environment and the conservation of natural resources. They developed a real passion for collecting, preserving and studying natural elements, making them true collectors. Their skill in the art of crystallomancy and resinology is unrivaled, and their expertise is often sought by other clans and peoples across the galaxy.</br></br>The Wicaksana are guardians of ancestral wisdom and knowledge linked to natural resources. Their contribution to the galaxy extends beyond their home planet, and their presence is respected and sought after by those who seek to maintain the balance between technology and nature. Their wisdom and humility are appreciated, and they often inspire other peoples to reconnect with nature and respect the riches it offers.</br></br>Thus, the Wicaksanas, with their unique appearance and mastery of natural resources, stand proudly among the clans of the Milky Way, reminding everyone of the importance of preserving the beauty and power of nature in an ever-changing universe.

qikaa.1.title: Qikaa: lost in hyperspace
qikaa.1.description: The feeling is strange. Not deeply unpleasant but with a unique torpor never before felt.
qikaa.1.text:
Day -7. / Autonomous navigation. / Direction - Kuna. / E.T.A - 7 days.

The feeling is strange. Not deeply unpleasant but with a unique torpor never before felt. I don't have the patriotic pride of representing my clan, or even the thrill of being Ashak. I wouldn't say that it doesn't matter to me... But I don't feel any particular emotion, I think that's mainly what it is. It's not as powerful as I might have imagined. In fact, that's what being Keludian is, you're taught not to feel anything. Kelud teaches you to suppress your feelings, to warm fear and cool emotion. It anesthetizes, it sucks in happiness as much as sadness. She's empty. It dries up.
Hyperspace travel always has this ability to push you into introspection. It's not like crossing in a grounder*, no, hyperspeed has a very unique flavor.

*ground ship with gyroscopic movement

I know I'm not prepared enough for what awaits me there. I haven't researched WildTech and other than Orus I don't have the slightest idea who my opponents will be. I have always had this almost insolent self-confidence, a detachment from events, and I would say that it has been rather successful for me so far. So why change now?
In fact that's what surprises me the most, I don't feel much responsibility, no weight on my shoulders, and yet I have the future of all Keludians between the hands. Does that make me a bad person?
I haven't eaten anything since I left, so maybe all of this is working on me a bit. I'll try to sleep.

“Orus? .. It's you ? You know I'm terribly sorry for... No, don't go so fast! Orus! “ - Another one of those fucking dreams…

I can't help but go through Subarashi's belt, it's stronger than me. It costs me half a super-luminal day but what the fuck is it beautiful. When I was younger I fantasized about this constellation, there were so many things said about the Subarashi on Kelud. The richest and most prosperous planets gravitate there. They have everything, the resources, breathtaking landscapes, perfect climates. All. What about us?
What's the thing with luck, what gives you the right to be born there and I'm born an orphan on a shitty planet… I feel like I'm just complaining. I don't even know why I'm talking to you anyway, you're just a damn algorithm.

“ I take it from you Qikaa, I'm a very sharp algorithm you know. I didn't cut you off in your monologue but you got a VR message from the network. Do you want me to read it?”.

qikaa.2.title: Qikaa: Life on an austere planet
qikaa.2.description: In the barren depths of Kelud, Qikaa stood alone, a lone figure towering against the harsh winds and swirling sandstorms.
qikaa.2.text:
Day 0. / Kelud. / Imminent departure

Day of departure to WildTech. I didn't wait for this moment. Like no other. I was chosen and I did nothing for it. I was chosen. For my skills I guess. I learned to manage... Today I manage... well. This is surely what pleased them.

I am Qikaa, which means dust in Keludian. That's good, that's all there is to it. My clan settled on Kelud generations ago...the rulers thought they would find fertile and abundant land there. Except Kelud's Dried Lava isn't. It is arid, sterile and irritating. The human always makes the same mistakes, he believes that what he knows is universal. Once his back is against the wall, he has the choice, admit his mistake and rectify the situation, or refuse this truth and persist… Leaders are what they are. To admit the failure of the choice of our planet was to lose face and recognize their inability to lead the Keludians towards a better future. So they told us that Kelud would be our home. As you might expect, Kelud is not known for its hospitality. Following the decision to stay and live there, numerous revolts took place. Governments were dismissed, new ones arrived with hopes and ended up falling like the previous ones. Even before I was born, it was no longer part of the Batur system's trade agreements. Sponsors were too often plundered and no longer found it profitable to come and trade there. Poverty and inevitably the black market and violence grew. This is the world I grew up in. I was born after the democratization of hyperspeed, when I think about it, that’s what saved me. I learned to fly very young, so I could escape far away. Without that, I can't imagine what I would have become. What a relief. At 13 I exchanged my first hyper-nef for a few services and I was able to taste freedom. I don't think I've ever experienced anything more enjoyable than my first night in space, with the hyperspeed lever stuck at full throttle, with no specific destination. Sleep between systems, far from Kelud, far from hell, far from dust. It was Orus, a veteran of Helgafell, who found me stranded on the borders of the Milky Way. In my quest for freedom I had gotten lost, unaware of the dangers I faced.

When I learned that I was going to have to face it in WildTech, I was shocked. nausea.

What are the chances of this happening seriously. He's probably the only person I respect in this fucking galaxy. [...]

[...]

Today, I am what we call a resinist, I smuggle resin from the Mauvabord forests, for the highest and most deserving bidders. Let's say that going to the planets furthest from their star and confronting the Mauvebark guardians to sell the resin to those who keep the wars going is not my thing.

I live at the expense of rules and prohibitions. I am Qikaa, like dust I slip and interfere in the interstices of hyperspace...

atmos.1.description: In the confines of a frigid planet, where snowstorms swirled relentlessly, lived Atmos, an enigmatic and fascinating being.
atmos.1.text:

Palaven – 01 / 30 / 3221

Contact report: Project_Rivals_4RSGC1

Report author: Nega Ugdira
Rank: Commander of the Network research brigade
Mothership: USG-ISHIMURA
Clan #4: The Shapeshifters
Estimated mission difficulty: Unknown
Mission status: Successful
Losses: 0

Prior knowledge of the Clan

Location: Bras Écu-Croix (Bras du Centaur).

Attribution planets: Data deleted from the Network Databases.

Presence planets: Data deleted from the Network Databases.

Demographics: Data erased from Network Databases.

Political system: Data erased from Network Databases.< /br>
Economic system: Data erased from Network Databases.

Owned technologies: Data erased from Databases of the Network.

Other: Data deleted from the Network Databases.

Clan Research

Insufficient accreditation .

Contact

Day-341: We were starting to lose hope when we decided to tackle the system [-]. We quickly realized that the Shapeshifters did not want to be found and regularly innovated our research methods. Agent [Atmos]'s instincts had saved our lives a bunch of times and I had given him the opportunity to choose our next destination. We were at this level of desolation, relying on the instinct of a squad member to continue our research.

The [-] system, chosen by the agent [Atmos] corresponded to the criteria of our theory; remote, with few planets and all with harsh climates. Ideal for living hidden and not attracting attention.

From the exosphere of the planet [-], we observed numerous luminous phenomena coming from the surface. We put forward hypotheses involving the extremely low temperatures of the surface and its frozen soils reflecting the light emitted by its numerous moons, themselves bombarded by the three red dwarfs of the system. But the [Atmos] agent previously assigned to the Network's artifact search team expressed his concern to us. The phenomenon we experienced was comparable to what he had experienced with the [-] artifact, which is only activated in contact with intelligent organic life.

We understood that we had arrived to destination. Our journey was about to end and we were finally going to encounter the Shapeshifters.

The scan of the planet was complete and we were establishing several approach and withdrawal strategies. Just in case.

We were just messengers, but we knew we wouldn't be welcome. And the message that we had come to serve was certainly not going to please their recipients.

The squad began its descent on the planet [-] when the light phenomena recurred, but in a much higher intensity. The agent [Atmos] had briefed the team, if this phenomenon occurred, it meant that we would be separated.

At this moment. He looked at us all in turn, smiling. No fear in his eyes. His confidence was such that we felt it.

He opened his mouth and spoke to us with the words “I'm so sorry, please know that I have always been honest about my feelings towards you. »

In this incomprehension, we all lost consciousness and I found my senses on the surface of the planet.

Separated from the others.

Face to me, a silhouette that I could barely make out because of the blizzard.

Exhibits

→ Start of the audio recording of agent Nega Ugdira, Commander of the Network research brigade...

Nega Ugdira: “Commander Ugdira reporting! You receive me ? Ishimura Squad, report!

Fuck! [Atmos] forgot to specify that our transmitters would be broken!

At least my suit is intact.

Physical integrity report! »

Combination: “You lost consciousness following an abnormally high peak of stress. Once unconscious, your vital constants have become stable again. However, as Agent [Atmos] predicted, it appears that you have been teleported approximately 100 kilometers south of the intended extraction location. »

Nega Ugdira: “Shit! What the fuck?! »

??? : “Hello Commander. »

N: “My intuition was right! Hello Shapeshifter, finally you show yourself!

Who do I have the honor of? »

Shapeshift: “Your reputation is well-founded, direct and frank! I am Draa'r. I'm your Shapeshifter equivalent. »

N: “Have you been following us since the beginning? »

Draa'r: “Not really. Since the Great Assignment to Clans by the Network, we have placed our best elements in many institutions. We withdrew from the world because you were not ready for our evolution. At the time, our transformations were minor, but they caused us great harm.

Our exile saved us, but we did not abandon you. »

N: “I don’t believe it, the agent [Atmos] is one of yours? Where is the rest of my squad? »

D: “Don’t worry about your men. You are the only one who has been displaced and as long as you don't do anything rash, everything will be fine.

Indeed, agent [Atmos] is a Shapeshifter. If it reassures you, despite his membership in the Clan, he is very loyal to you. He has been pleading in your favor since he joined your team, he is a big supporter of the return of the Clan to the world.

N: “Why tell me everything That ? Why take the risk of meeting me when you seem to know everything? »

D: “The biological evolution of the agent [Atmos] is very useful for knowing the real intentions of individuals, in return, it binds very quickly to the others. Problematic for a spy but he has enough experience to manage this problem and if he is also attached to you, it is because he considers you.

I wanted to meet you because I respects you. In many ways, we are similar.

For the past year, you have been responsible for this hunt. She has led you through many dangers and you have always managed to get your men out of them unscathed.

The Shapeshifters see you as someone they can trust and we wish to reward your perseverance. You were supposed to send us our invitation to Rivals. In return, we hope that you can communicate to the world our upcoming return. »

N: “That’s a lot! And who will be your champion? »

D: “You know him well. »

→ End of audio recording...

xhan.1.title: Xhan: Interview for Sputnik
xhan.1.description: Adored scientist, renowned archaeologist, musician in his spare time.
xhan.1.text:
Xhan Banut, better known as Spanner the Cyber-Architect is not only a renowned architect.

Adored scientist, renowned archaeologist, musician in his spare time, he tried his hand – in the past – in politics before retiring following the internal scandals in our former government that he revealed. at the Strana and then disbanded.

Following his nomination for Ashak status for the Rivals showdown that will decide our fate in 10 years, many are wondering who he is.

I am Irina Magomedov, journalist at Sputnik and today we meet for the interview of the most famous architect of the Strana!


Irina: Hello, first of all, what should I call you? Spanner? Xhan Banut?

Spanner: Ha ha, hello Irina. You can call me Spanner, like my relatives do.

I: Ok! It's a pleasure to have you here! After years away from the media scene, here you are, against your will, back! Let's go back if you like. What was your reaction 10 days ago following the government's announcement?

S: I'm not going to lie to you, I learned of my appointment ago was 2 days old and my feeling was anger.
I was returning from research in Cyberspace. I had no idea why my face was on the front page. What's more, associated with words like "chosen one" and "Ashak" or anxiety-provoking riddles like "Can we trust him?" ".

I ended up calling a relative who offered me his condolences on my appointment as Ashak.
That didn't help matters..., my anger was even more intense.

I: So you were in Cyberspace…, what were you doing there?

S: Partly yes. I learned that more and more groups were launching into the unknown to escape certain “constraints” that we know well in the Way. Whatever their reasons – good or bad – the feedback I have been able to receive is promising. The only thing I can tell you is that, like the Network, I seek solutions to our problems, but unlike them, I do not seek to sacrifice mine.

I : Am I to understand that your anger is linked to the Network?

Spanner takes a pack of cigarettes from his pocket and lights one.

S : Indeed, I have a past with the Network and like us, I understand the usefulness of such an entity but I severely doubt its choices and methods.

I: However, in the past, you too had somewhat messy methods?

S : Should I remind you that if the Strana is what Is it today because I had these “borderline” methods? We were in a clearly dictatorial system, bordering on systemic indoctrination. From our birth to our death we served the Strana without personal interest. At this level, it’s surprising that we haven’t gotten to the Matryoshka brain! Like every member of our people, I served. During my time in the army, I was exemplary! Full of good convictions, I was ready to give my life to set an example and make the Strana shine in the Way! For decades we were naive... When I realized it, I had all the cards in my hands to provide a solution for my people. So I acted.

I don't have the same methods as the Network.
Choose 6 clans at random to make them compete in an arena developed by technology that we understand too little and all that to ultimately banish the losers from the Way, I don't call that a solution.

Overthrow a corrupt government that alienates its people for the interest of a handful of individuals and replace it with an Athenian democracy, that's a solution, my solution. Despite the losses we may have suffered. I fully assume this responsibility and it is for this reason that I withdrew and refused any role in our new decision-making institution. Today I am focused on my research, always with the aim of serving the Strana and am regularly consulted by our peers for my wise advice.

I: …

S: I got carried away, ah ah. But still. Reading the Network's press release concerning Rivals, we all said to ourselves: “what the hell are they doing?!”.

I : Indeed, this feeling is justified and I am sure that many in the Strana join you. You were talking about a liability with the Network, can you tell us more?

S: Attention Irina, I'm starting to think that you want to maintain this anger that I unveiled you!

I: I wouldn't put it that way. Let's just say we share that sentiment. We are suffering an injustice, like the one you saved us from years ago. At that moment you were almost alone, a handful of individuals. Today I speak on behalf of the Strana, you are no longer alone! We like to see that this anger is collective, it animates us, gives us strength. Seeing you with this combativeness helps us.

S: These are words that please you. Let's maintain this anger then.

I will tell you.
In my humble way, I have spent my life excavating old sites in dark sectors of the Way. I am in Cyberspace, which is full of more life than we can say, than we have been told.
I'm looking for artifacts, new life forms, anything that could help our cause.
Part of the key to my work lies in the hands of the Network.
I: The Karnakan?

S: I received a refusal when the Network was looking for scientists to study its technology.
In a message full of condescension, they made me understand that I was too unstable to work with them. To believe that the old regime of the Strana was more beneficial to them.

Since then, the only thing they have been able to get from Karnakan is a fucking arena in which the destiny of 6 Clans.
We know, this technology is not human. I own technologies that have similar characteristics. But I have no way of proving it.
What tells them that the intelligence that brought back the Karnakan didn't leave other artifacts in the past?
The The key is there, before our eyes, we must learn and decipher it.

I: You mean that those who left Karnakan did so to help us?

S: Probably. But it is too early to say. This lead is the best we have, but it is in the hands of an entity that controls us. I draw a parallel with our past situation and that gives me ideas.

I: Are you insinuating that we should rebel against the Network?

S: Not necessarily. But what will happen when they have to knock 5 Clans out of the way? What if we are part of it? The first time, no one believed it. Some time has passed since then. I prepare for all eventualities and I don't think I'm the only one.

I: That's reassuring... and what do you think of the Strana's immediate choice of you?

S: As I told you, my feeling at this announcement was anger . But let me be clear, this anger is aimed at the Network.
When the former government fell, I was clear. I was born to serve my people and I would give anything for them. Past indoctrination has left traces in all of us. Even if my devotion is a result of it, it is the one I gladly embrace. La Strana did well.

I demonstrated my ability to come out unscathed from rather unconventional situations.
We are capable of great things. I designed the plans for Asimov IV, the first entirely artificial planet which is today close to self-sufficiency, real progress!
My knowledge and the technologies that I have accumulated during my research and travels will allow me to transcend the Network and the hold it has on our people.

I am not alone. You confirmed it to me, the Strana too, by naming me. My teams and I are determined.

I: Once again, you prove to us that you are worthy of your place. On behalf of the Strana, our faith in you is unshakeable.

S: Do not be afraid. No matter the outcome, we will rise again.
We will show them!

I: One is all.

S: Everything is one.

End of interview.

wicaksanas.2.title: Wicaksanas: A destiny linked to crystal
wicaksanas.2.description: In the forgotten meanders of Samun, the Wicaksanas carried the weight of a dark heritage, a history buried beneath the veils of a seemingly untouchable beauty.
wicaksanas.2.text: In the forgotten meanders of Samun, the Wicaksanas carried the weight of a dark heritage, a history buried under the veils of a seemingly untouchable beauty. Amid the sparkling crystals and majestic trees lurked a complex reality, marked by tragedy and sacrifice.</br></br>At the heart of this tale was a Wicaksana named Elara. His soul was tormented by the dark secrets of his clan, secrets that weighed on his shoulders like unbearable burdens. From a young age, she felt an eerie presence, dark whispers that seemed to emanate from the depths of Samun.</br></br>Elara was hungry for truth, but her search was constantly hampered by the silence imposed by the elders. Wicaksanas. The doors of the archive rooms closed in front of her, the forbidden stories were hidden behind impenetrable walls. She was condemned to live in the shadow of a story that refused to be told.</br></br>Driven by her thirst for knowledge and her desire to unravel the mysteries buried, Elara embarked on a solitary quest . She traveled the most remote regions of Samun, in search of answers in forgotten places, where nature intertwined with the remains of ancestors.</br></br>During her wanderings, she discovered enigmatic clues, ancient symbols engraved on ancient rocks. But each revelation seemed to open a new wound, awakening the pains of a past that sought to be forgotten. The whispers of history intensified, revealing a truth that threatened to shatter the delicate balance of the Wicaksanas.</br></br>Elara finally entered the forbidden cavern, a shrine hidden deep within the mountains. The flickering flames of the torches illuminated the dark frescoes that told the story of the Wicaksanas, a story stained with blood and betrayal.</br></br>She discovered that the crystals so revered by her family, these jewels of a rare beauty, were in fact the fruit of a terrible curse. The Wicaksanas were bound to these stones by an ancient pact, where each generation had to offer a sacrifice to nurture their power.</br></br>Sadness took hold of Elara's soul, who now realized that the splendor of the crystals was tinged with a dark reality. The Wicaksanas, blinded by their love for these gems, had condemned themselves to perpetuate a cycle of suffering and mourning.</br></br>Devastated by this revelation, Elara found herself alone, trapped between the fascination for beauty of Samun and the horror of the history that was playing out within it. She now understood why the ancients had remained silent, why they had chosen to veil the darkness in favor of wonder.</br></br>But the truth could not be contained forever. As Elara's consciousness grew heavier with the burden of secrets, she felt like a stranger in her own community. The light of the crystals filled her with nothing but bitterness, and she realized that she had to break this cycle of suffering and sacrifice.</br></br>Elara made the bold decision to leave Samun, separate from his clan and devote himself to a new quest: finding a way to break the curse that had chained the Wicaksanas for centuries. She wandered across the galaxy, seeking allies, knowledge, and means to accomplish this arduous task.</br></br>Her journey was fraught with pitfalls and dangers, but Elara persevered with determination. She learned new arts, initiated herself into ancient knowledge and formed unlikely alliances. His name spread throughout the Milky Way, becoming synonymous with courage and will.</br></br>And one day, when she had acquired the necessary power and wisdom, Elara returned to Samun, ready to face the darkness of her past. She stood before the elders, revealing the truth hidden for too long. His voice resonated with a force that broke the silence, and the Wicaksanas were confronted with the harsh reality of their history.</br></br>Some refused to believe, preferring to remain blinded by the hypnotic glow of the crystals. But others listened to Elara, rallying to her cause and deciding to break with the traditions that linked them to the curse. A silent rebellion awoke, and little by little, the Wicaksanas broke away from the cursed gems.</br></br>Today, the Wicaksanas fight to restore harmony between themselves and their planet.They continue to preserve nature and seek ways to heal the wounds inflicted by the past. Their story is that of a rebirth, of a people who chose to face their demons and create a future where beauty and pain are no longer inseparable.</br></br>Thus, the The shadow that hung over the Wicaksanas was transformed into a glimmer of hope, a powerful lesson about the need to question established truths and find the strength to change the course of one's destiny. The Wicaksanas are no longer blind collectors of Samun's treasures, but enlightened guardians, seeking to restore balance and preserve the very essence of their existence.

gyaleis.1.title: Gyaléïs : Programmus Pax
gyaleis.1.description: If we omit the emotional dimension, a newborn baby is ultimately just a machine just waiting to be programmed.
gyaleis.1.text: “If we omit the emotional dimension, a newborn is ultimately just a machine that just needs to be programmed.” - Treatise on hyper-programmability, Livalds Tornus, 1991</br></br>Day 1687: Exercise: Survival</br>Number of projectiles received: 0</br>Rate of targets hit: 100% </br >Maximum heart rate during exercise: 52 bpm</br>Comments: Gyaleïs once again beat her speed course record twice in a row.I still can't understand how his muscles are capable of such progress in such a short time. Certainly, the G12 program includes intense, daily physical training, but it seems to me that it far exceeds the capabilities that a human is capable of achieving, especially given their age. I was never able to find out what mixture she was injecting herself with and whether it was responsible for her physical prowess. As usual, she categorically refuses to reveal her recipe and the expected effects.</br></br>Day 1687: Phase: Free expression</br>[...] A few drops of Alcisya… 6… 7… 8. She directs her reinforced Erlenmeyer flask onto the iON-15-6 solar convector . Gyaleïs, what are you still cooking up... She sits calmly on her tree stump, as usual, then stares at her preparation, impassive. I'm still surprised that she chooses to spend all her free time doing chemistry tests and other crafts.And again, I say tests, but the term is hardly representative of the results obtained. Each attempt is crowned with success, sometimes surpassing current scientific knowledge. Especially since the G12 program does not provide any child programming concerning chemistry. It is as if it naturally understands the matter that surrounds us, as if it could decompose the smallest atom and deduce all the interactions with the other elements.Both the best and the worst.</br></br>Day 1689: Free Commentary</br>How could such an incident happen? Who could have thought that it would be good to allow a novice to interact with Gyaleïs? I'm terribly sorry for being careless. It is potentially the G12 program that could be called into question or even compromised... And why did Gyaleïs prepare an explosive potion before even knowing who was going to pick her up to take her away after her program? Why did that fool want to take his strength potion? Did she anticipate it? And above all, why did she have this unhealthy smile, accompanied by inexhaustible tears? I feel like I'm missing out on something… but what?</br></br>Day 1691: Free Commentary</br>In view of the turn events are taking, I prefer to stop my contribution to the G12 project. I started this diary more than five years ago, a diary that traces the entirety of the G12 project, ranging from reflections on its development to the tragedy of recent days, including all of Gyaleïs' follow-up.My heart aches at the idea of ​​abandoning the one I consider today to be my daughter. And yet, the incident opened my eyes. We, the Pacifös, have failed. Blinded by our quest for absolute peace and by aversion to violence, we deliberately made the choice to dehumanize a child to transform her into an implacable weapon of war in order to ensure our salvation. How could such a thing have been envisaged? Out of selfishness? Out of pride? Either way, we betrayed ourselves in the worst way possible. Rivals was a test of our pacifist faith, testing the limits of our beliefs and we failed miserably...Gyaleïs is an incredible child, so talented. She has the right to a dignified and happy life, to love and kindness, non-negotiable elements of healthy mental health. But isn't it too late now?</br>On second thought, this isn't about giving up, this is about getting my daughter out of the hell I threw her into, before the Rivals happen...</br ></br>Day 1693: Appointment of new holder</br>Name: Swözok</br>First name: Merkous</br>Matricule: G12-001/B</br>Habilitation: Maximum</br>Comment: “ Programmus Pax” 1</br></br>1: The motto of the Pacifös. In order to achieve absolute peace and sobriety, the Pacifös impose a strict and iterative education inspired by the programming of artificial intelligences.

gyaleis.2.title: Gyaléïs: A life on Phermon
gyaleis.2.description: Four years had passed since I left the G12 program.
gyaleis.2.text: Four years had passed since I left the G12 program. Phermon, the primitive planet that had taken me in, was a web of intrigue and mystery that had fascinated me as much as it had frightened me. </br></br>The forests of Florechantante, cradle of my refuge, were overflowing with luxuriant flora that I had worked to study tirelessly.Every day I discovered new creatures with extraordinary shapes and properties. The Sylvansardes, arachnids with emerald eyes, showed a disconcerting intelligence. The Vorgalhorns, both graceful and poisonous plant serpents, had been my greatest source of wonder. </br></br>I baptized them that way, creating names for these strange beings that seemed to me as familiar as they were unfamiliar. My cabin in Astrevert, with its rudimentary laboratory, had become my sanctuary to study the healing properties and toxic potentials of this incredible fauna and flora.</br></br>I love this planet which gives me the feeling of being able to complete quests and discover natural treasures. I'm looking for a treasure, why not a magic chest that will give me the answers to all my questions about nature, plant and animal life. These discoveries lead me to other discoveries, like a hunt, a perpetual pursuit towards greater knowledge. </br></br>My research was not all reassuring. In the dark depths of the forests, I had encountered hostile creatures that I had named The Frozen Shadows, creatures fallen from the light of day. Their aggression and malevolence seemed to come from Phermon's fragile balance, as if nature itself had to defend itself against its own excesses. </br></br>However, within this darkness there was also a glimmer of hope. I had discovered a group of bioluminescent organisms that I had named Les Lumiépines. These magical creatures lit the dark paths, dispelling nighttime fears and guiding my steps in the darkness.These half-animal, half-plant creatures were at the center of my research for many months. Their potential is gigantic and I have only elucidated a tiny percentage of their complexity. Their extremophile organism is so adaptive that I managed to merge them with my skin. My glowthorns are scattered across my arms and legs. I feel that the more time passes, the more our DNA intertwines, I may be wrong but I believe that we will become one with time.

orus.1.title: Orus: Incarnation of Helga
orus.1.description: Transcendence of Orus. The day everything went dark.
orus.1.text:
On Helgafell, survival is an art. We are taught it as soon as we know how to walk and we transmit it as soon as we can no longer serve otherwise.

This planet is unstable and capricious. Acid rain affects the entire ecosystem of the planet, leading to many surprises.

On Helgafell, death has many faces.

At 15, we are sent to test our abilities. This first mission is decisive and decides our future place within the Clan.

Accompanied by 10 comrades, we had to, like our predecessors, go straight to the South Pole, to reach the metallurgical exploitation of the first settlers and bring back its metal to the unique alloy.

/br>According to the ancients, our arrival on this planet is a punishment that we inherit from our ancestors. But the alloy is a gift from the Gods, a sign of their mercy.

Centuries ago, after our Pioneers had suffered many losses, the territories of the Poles were granted to the Wildlife.She did not appreciate our presence and faced with our ignorance, we had no chance. This is what we were going to be faced with...

I have no memory of our expedition.
My first memory is of my awakening.
I remember holding a piece of the alloy.
So sparkling that my closed palm was not enough to retain its shine.
Too sparkling? I thought.
It felt like my legs were acting against my will, leading me towards familiar faces that were watching me and breaking down as I approached.

Then in an instant, this sensation stopped dead.
I was no longer me.
Like an astral journey, I observed my body from a new point of view.But he wasn't human.
I could see myself from above.
Lightning struck me. Lightning struck my body.

When I woke up, I still felt like myself.

One of the elders came to meet me and explained that through her lightning, the Goddess Helga had chosen me. That the sacrifice of my past life and my comrades was for the benefit of a divine power materialized through this artifact that I had brought back and that I thought was the alloy, mission for which we left.
< /br>I made him repeat his words.Then asked him about my comrades, our mission, our failure.
But his words penetrated me, I was empty, I felt immaterial.
And yet, my sight was clear and piercing, a force flowed through me, physically but also mentally.
Tired, I no longer listened to the old one and decided to get up to get some fresh air. When I took my first step, I collapsed to the ground.

My legs, instruments of my survival since my initiation into the arts of the Clan, were lifeless.

>For a second, the Gods had given and then taken back all meaning to my existence.
So that was their plan?
Let a child survive until he can do everything sacrifice and bring prosperity for his people?
Was I only destined to find this artifact?

I considered myself in that brief moment as a blessed lamb, that the we keep in reserve for a future sacrifice.
This sensation was quickly ejected by this force that I felt invading me. All negative thoughts were erased.
It was this moment that initiated my new life. Having no more past, I had to move forward and find meaning in my life.

My first memory dates back to when I was 15.
Today, at At the dawn of my 45th birthday, I carry the future of my Clan.
A few minutes before this confrontation, I am convinced that this is what I am preparing for.
I feel in my place.
Victory? Defeat ? It doesn't matter.
I was chosen by my people, this choice is worth a thousand prophecies and I know it, I will guide them towards a better future.

arduino.title: Incident: Arduino Bomberman
arduino.description: Arduino Bomberman is a Cataclysm-level incident that caused 54% of Earth to be destroyed.
arduino.text: Arduino Bomberman is a Cataclysm level incident that caused the destruction of 54% of the Earth.</br></br>This is also the name of the author of the incident.</br></br> A talented young member of the Xāwuṭh Clan, he is at the origin of the technology from which the star cannons will come.</br></br>Fearing that the Karnakan would cause the destruction of the Earth, he chose to test his new invention. The grenade, similar to a huge EMP, should, in theory, interrupt all activity of the machine.</br></br>When Arduino Bomberman triggered the grenade, it resonated with the Karnakan.</br ></br>In panic, Arduino tried to contain the effect with a magnetic field. Unfortunately, this strategy only accentuated the power emanating from the resonance and a few minutes of resistance later, he fell unconscious, exhausted.</br></br>At that moment, the resonance transformed into a blast sweeping across the globe and reducing 8 billion Earthlings to dust.</br></br>2 hours after the incident, intense seismic activities appeared everywhere on Earth.</br></br>1 hour later the Earth began to collapse on itself.</br></br>24 hours later another 1 billion had vanished and the remaining survivors began their evacuation via shuttles from the Moon and Mars.

description.title: At the dawn </br> of 3221
description.texte: Humanity is all over the galaxy. After centuries of research, science finally unraveled the secret of hyperspeed. </br> </br>The Network, supreme political council, sealed the destiny of all clans. In order to avoid the conflicts and wars to come, each clans located on each planet of the Milky Way will designate an Ashak to stand for them in the WildTech, a hybrid arena : half-real, half-digital. </br></br>You embody one of these Ashaks and will carry your clan's hopes. The ultimate battle is yet to come and no one wants to discover what is hiding beyond the void.

gameplay.intro: Rivals is played in several rounds, each divided into two rounds of play. During their turn, players have 2 action points to move, collect resources from a tile, play cards from their hand and interact with sponsors.

description.1: Follow the state of your opponents by consulting their boards. Health points, Ultimate charge, available Skills, take these elements into account to adapt your strategy.
description.2: Add Skills to your Ashak board to develop your power, increase your actions and your draw.

description1.part2: Explore, move and reap the tiles to prepare for your confrontations by refining your deck and building a solid defense! Don't overlook resources, they can save your life and win the game.

description2.part3: says unpredictability. Map tiles are never laid out the same way. Events will spice up the game! It's up to you to take advantage of it. At the end of each round, areas are disintegrated with everything it contained... Staying on the edge of the WildTech can prove fatal, but to venture into it too deeply too.

ashaks.intro: Chosen by their clan, Ashaks are synonymous for hope. The future of their people depends on their victory at the Rivals.

1.name: Cyber hacking
1.description: This knowledge is legislated by the laws of the network. Only the Ashaks or the representatives of the order can legally make use of it. It was invented by the Naomancers, a very distant clan of Kelud, it is also quite rare for a Keludian to practice it.
1.action: discard 1 random card from your target's hand.

2.name: cyberspace slum
2.description: Although born on Kelud, Qikaa spent much of her young life in the rubble of cyberspace. There she discovered the intricacies of technology.
2.action: Pay 1 resource unit then install 1 card among the 3 cards at the top of the interface.

ulti.name: the loot is mine!
ulti.description: Life on Kelud is difficult. This planet on the edge of nothingness concentrates the largest population of thugs. Qikaa has developed, like many Keludians, a fine knowledge of piracy.
ulti.action: Uninstall up to 2 maps and gain 2 resource units for each map uninstalled.

qikaa.quote: Luck ? I never had to use that…
qikaa.description: From an early age, Qikaa has played with rules and prohibitions to lead a wandering existence. This life has given her great knowledge and self-confidence. With a quick and resourceful mind, she always got out of the worst situations.

1.name: ATX equipment
1.description: ATX equipment is a MOD that each member of the Lightning Hawks is allocated on integration.

2.name: hawk's eye
2.description: Orus' experience, coupled with Helga's clairvoyance, enables him to detect even the most hidden of enemy vulnerabilities.

orus.quote: A victory without challenge has a bitter taste.
orus.description: A veteran of Helgafell, a more than inhospitable planet where survival is an art, Orus has distinguished himself throughout his life by numerous achievements. His experience allows him to always keep his cool and establish the best strategy to lead him to victory.

1.name: Ram's punch
1.action: Reduce your max range by 2. +1 damage.
1.description: Atmos secretes large quantities of keratin. Imposing horns appear on his skull and snap off as soon as they penetrate an organic body.

2.name: Cheetah Leap
2.action: Teleport to the same hex as your target then inflict 2 damage.
2.description: Atmos' morphology evolves. His spine extends to enable him to leap at his target from a great distance.

ulti.name: Flight of the raptor
ulti.description: Shapeshifters, once transformed, have all the abilities of the animal whose form they take. This makes them formidable warriors, fast, versatile and unpredictable.
ulti.action: Move up to 4 hexes. Draw 1 card and gain 1 action point.

atmos.description: In addition to being part of the first generations to innately master therianthropy, Atmos does not seem limited in the amount of transformation. Acting as a double agent among the Network's elite, he is tasked by his Clan with judging whether the time has come for the Shapeshifters to resurface. Allocentric, his appointment to the Rivals as Ashak upsets his vision of the world. He must now prepare to think of himself before others.

1.name: Cyber ​​Overload
1.description: Xhan releases a large quantity of energy stored in his exoskeleton to deploy an energy shield.

2.name: Digital cloning
2.action: get 1 resource unit you already own.
2.description: The left hand of Xhan's exoskeleton enables him to break down and analyze the elements he touches, while his right hand enables him to reproduce a synthetic copy.

xhan.quote: One is all. All is one..
xhan.description: Nicknamed "Hope of the Nation" after overthrowing the former dictatorial regime of his people, Xhan Banut is a renowned scientist with many hats. His devotion to his clan is powerful and whatever the outcome of the coming battles, he will always be one step ahead.

1.name: dark bramble
1.action: choose 1 ashak on a tile with a forest, it loses 1VP. If he is on the forest space, he loses 2VP instead.
1.description: Yosh probes the ground for targets and attacks them instantly.

2.name: Tree protection
2.action: Until the start of your next turn, if you are on a tile with a forest, you can re-roll each of your dodge dice once.
2.description: Yosh fuses part of his body with his environment to create an imposing vegetal barrier.

ulti.description: Children of the forest, the BadBark guardians possess abilities sometimes unknown to the Network. The Resin has given them terrible toxic powers that are often fatal. After a certain amount of time spent in a new environment, Yosh can corrupt it to make the air toxic and poison his opponents.
ulti.action: Spread 3 poison tokens over the player(s) of your choice.

yosh.description: The Network has very little information relating to Clan Purplebark. They are among the clans that have diverged the most from the initial human biological state. This powerful evolution granted them the ability to manipulate nature, giving them a huge advantage and many surprise effects.

1.name: Swarm of flashers
1.action: Place 1 flasher in your target's deck. You can repeat this effect on another target.
1.description: created by Renko, flashers are originally pacifists. He reprogrammed them during Rivals to make them deadly parasites.

2.name: Acceleration Drone
2.action: Your target reveals the top 3 cards of his deck to you and activates all the revealed flashers. If your target has at least 1 flasher, it loses 1VP otherwise draw 1 card.
2.description: once his flashers are in place, Renko executes his plan to inflict heavy damage on his target.

ulti.name: Lethal Flashers
ulti.description: Don't let yourself be distracted by Flashers. More vicious than insects, they won't give you a chance.
ulti.action: +1 max range until the end of the round. Activate 1 flasher on your target. All of that player's flashers are revealed and activated, then your target shuffles their deck and discard pile.

renko.description: Renko is an exceptional sniper who has optimized his tracking technique thanks to his Drones, which he manipulates to perfection. Linked to his mind, each of his drones is directly connected to him, making him the centerpiece of his swarm.

1.name: Invigorating Capsule
1.action: Roll 3 dice, each success heals your target by 1 HP.
1.description: Gyaleis concocts a healing elixir from the plants around her.

2.name: Adhesive ammo
2.action: If your target loses at least 1VP, all their movements are limited to 1 space maximum during their next turn and you draw 1 card.
2.description: Gyaleis adds a decoction of insects and plants to his ammunition to immobilize his opponents.

ulti.name: Natural radiation
ulti.description: Gyaleis' numerous experiments have profoundly altered her genetic structure, giving her the ability to emit radiation with a wide range of effects.
ulti.action: Players on the targeted tile take 4 damage and those on adjacent tiles take 3 damage. Target anticipation is unavailable during the ultimate.

gyaleis.description: Gyaleis' existence can be summed up in one objective: to win the Rivals. Her whole life has been governed by a series of endless experiments in which she has been the main subject.
